description: This file defines the MatrixFunctions class containing static methods for matrix operations such as sequence generation, determinant calculation, matrix inversion, multiplication, and identity matrix creation within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: MatrixFunctions
classes.description: A class providing static methods to perform various matrix operations such as sequence creation, determinant calculation, matrix inversion, multiplication, and identity matrix generation for use in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: getMatrix
methods.description: Converts input values into a Matrix object, validating and formatting the input.

methods.name: sequence
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers in an array based on specified dimension and start step.

methods.name: determinant
methods.description: Computes the determinant of a matrix.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of a matrix.

methods.name: identity
methods.description: Creates an identity matrix of specified dimension.
